extracted.name: Open-faced breakfast bagel
extracted.description: I wanted to "upgrade" my usual morning bagel. This is what I came up with.
ingredient_lines: Bagel of choice (I used an everything bagel)
1-2 Eggs (depending if you are eating just 1/2 the bagel or whole)
4 pcs Bacon (2 per slice), can use canadian bacon, ham, sausage, or no meat at all
instruction_lines: Toast the bagel. I buttered it when done.
Start your eggs. I fried mine, but scrambling them would work too.
I used microwave bacon bc it's easier, but if you really want to get into it with real bacon, I'd start it before the eggs.
Once all the pieces are done, start assembling. On each slice of buttered bagel, put an egg, cheese, and top it with bacon. I microwaved 10 secs to melt the cheese a bit more. Enjoy
If you're a Benedict eggs fan, making a hollandaise sauce would work nicely with this. (You'll have to look for that recipe elsewhere, though. 😆)
